matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades in the 97th percentile against a unit that grades 71st — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about this matchup: we're staring down the widest statistical edge on the board this week — our pass offense in the 97th percentile against a Steelers defense that grades 71st — and that's genuinely the kind of advantage you dream about. The problem is we're doing it without Carlton Davis III at cornerback, which is precisely the wrong time to be short-handed in coverage, even against a Steelers offense ranked 21st overall. Pittsburgh's recent form (0.02 net EPA per play over their last three) suggests they're beatable, and we've handled them well in recent history (3-2 in our last five meetings), but this is a bounce-back moment we can't afford to bungle. TreVeyon Henderson's back from that ankle, Mitch Wishnowsky's in for the second straight week, and we're favored by 5.5 — everything points to New England seizing this opportunity, assuming our pass game does what the numbers say it should.
